text:
anna: quick sanity check: can the edge give a tiny resume token (req id + offset + sig) so flaky clients can reconnect without heavy state? :eyes:

ben: short tokens sound good. main risk is replaying side effects. we must gate by idempotency intent.

carol: +1. propose header `Resume-Intent: at_least_once|exactly_once`. exact flows reject resumes.

dave: flow sketch:
1) edge emits `Resume-Token` in trailer while streaming
2) client reconnects with token
3) edge validates lease -> either resume or return `409 Resume-Expired`

ben: for resume hits: either edge serves from small cache or instruct upstream with `start_offset`. two modes: `edge-cache` and `upstream-range`.

anna: metrics: `resume_attempts`, `resume_hits`, `resume_misses`, `resume_evictions`, `resume_latency`. expose per-tenant.

infra-bot: storage limits: default edge lease TTL=60s, max per-edge=80k entries. watch eviction rates.

carol: security: HMAC tokens per-tenant, include version tag for rotation. keep token size <128B for mobile proxies.

dave: fallback behavior: prefer `103 Early-Resume` with `Backoff` header when upstream busy, else `409` for expired. that reduces hedging storms.

ben: operational plan: RFC for token format + intent header, prototype single-region LRU metadata store, add feature-flag + metrics, canary on low-traffic tenants.

anna: will draft RFC and add test harness simulating churn. cc @ben @carol @dave.

infra-bot: maintenance notice: edge-lease service upgrades tomorrow 02:00 UTC may briefly change TTLs.

ben: noted.
